releaseNotes:
• Bulletproof Dynamic Island HUD State Machine: Implemented monotonic operationId lease tokens and per-state hard TTL watchdogs (LinkDetected=4s, Resolving=10s, Downloading=18s, Success=2.4s, Error=3.5s) via collectLatest, mathematically guaranteeing the HUD pill can never freeze or stay stuck under camera cutouts.
• Structured Concurrency & NonCancellable Guards: Wrapped download workflows in runHudTrackedOperation with automatic timeout and cancellation handling to safely dismiss or surface errors even if background jobs abort.
• Fast-Fail Circuit Breakers: Bypasses unauthenticated GraphQL endpoints in <1ms on 302/401/429 rate/login challenges with a 10-minute cooldown, eliminating cold-start stalls and IP throttling.
• Multi-Pattern Reel & Video Extraction: Expanded captioned embed fallback with multi-variant video tag matching, JSON video versions, and CDN MP4 links, resolving Reels and videos in ~250ms without headless WebView delays.
• 1-Tap Dismiss & Clean Lifecycle: Quick tap on the HUD pill dismisses it immediately across all apps, and FloatingTriggerService cleanly purges overlays upon service stop or task removal.
